evaluatedInput.heading_path: /Operations Manual — Acme Pipeline Co. NPS 24 Crude Oil System/Pipeline Integrity Management Program
evaluatedInput.text:
Acme operates a pipeline integrity management program (PIM) consistentwith CSA Z662 and CER OPR. The program covers:
threat identification (external corrosion, internal corrosion,geohazards, third-party damage, manufacturing defects)
ILI scheduling on a five-year cadence
monitoring via cathodic protection surveys, close-interval surveys,and pressure cycling analysis
corrective-action triggers tied to API 1163 ILI tool tolerance.
